# ZIO

> Type-safe, composable asynchronous and concurrent programming for Scala.

This file contains links to documentation sections following the llmstxt.org standard.

- [Associative](https://zio.dev/zio-prelude/functional-abstractions/concrete-types/associative.md): `Associative[A]` describes a way of combining two values of type `A` that is associative.

- [Equal](https://zio.dev/zio-prelude/functional-abstractions/concrete-types/equal.md): `Equal[A]` describes the ability to compare two values of type `A` for equality.

- [Identity](https://zio.dev/zio-prelude/functional-abstractions/concrete-types/identity.md): `Identity[A]` describes a data type with an associative combining operation that also has an identity element.

- [Inverse](https://zio.dev/zio-prelude/functional-abstractions/concrete-types/inverse.md): `Inverse[A]` describes a type that has a `combine` operator and also has an `inverse` operator that is the inverse of the `combine` operator.
- [Ord](https://zio.dev/zio-prelude/functional-abstractions/concrete-types/ord.md): `Ord[A]` describes a total ordering on values of type `A`.
